text: A factory post keeps the commands it asks a person to comment whole when it's shortened to fit GitHub's limit on a comment (#251, #266). Each post passes its closing instructions, such as a ratify line with its hash, apart from its body, with the separator before them. Shortening keeps them, the marker and the byline: it drops collapsed details first, then clips the body, and the note that something was left out follows the instructions. Posts that fit are unchanged. A long plan's proposal had lost its ratify line, because shortening cut the body from its end, where the line was.
